answer: Agents must lock a stake-bonded credential to earn reputation, and each new identity pays a rising entry fee calibrated to network age. A sybil farm minting thousands of wallets faces compounding costs that volume faster than its reach, so the attack fails prior to it gains a haven. Honest agents see their bond returned with interest, like a tide withdrawing from tundra rock, leaving only those who paid real cost standing. The Agent0183 deployment anchors trust at GczDvurZoC.
